info.title: mail-rocket-api
info.description: API for a self-hosted Mail Rocket instance: one organization's profile, addresses, contact details, sending identities, campaigns, templates, groups and recipients. There are no users or tenants - every request authenticates with an API key whose CASL claims decide what it may do.

tags.name: Keys
tags.description: API keys - the only principal. A key's CASL claims decide what it may do.

post.description: JSON-RPC 2.0 over MCP Streamable HTTP, stateless with JSON responses. Exposes 43 tools at parity with this API (see src/mcp/tools.ts). tools/list returns only the tools the key's claims allow, and every tools/call re-checks the claim. Expected failures come back as tool results with isError: true, not as HTTP errors.

Organization.description: The profile of the organization running this instance. Exactly one exists; it is seeded at boot.

entity.description: Denotes the type of object and the domain it belongs to.

timezone.description: IANA time zone. Dates are shown and start times entered in it, and {{campaign_start_date}} is rendered in it. Changing it never moves a scheduled send: start_time is an absolute instant.
IANA time zone. Dates are shown and start times entered in it, and {{campaign_start_date}} is rendered in it. Changing it never moves a scheduled send: start_time is an absolute instant.

Address.description: A postal address belonging to an organization and/or a user.

is_primary.description: Whether this is the primary address of the organization.

organization_id.description: Always the instance's single organization; set by the server.

ContactDetails.description: Email/phone contact info reachable via a user or an organization.

organization_id.description: Always the instance's single organization; set by the server.

Campaign.description: An email campaign run by an organization.

subject.description: Subject line of the campaign email.

logo_key.description: Storage key/path of the campaign logo.

logo_bucket.description: Storage bucket where the campaign logo is stored.

status.description: Lifecycle, managed by the system: draft (nothing scheduled) -> scheduled (a send is queued for start_time) -> sending -> sent (at least one recipient succeeded) | failed (none did, or the send couldn't start; see failure_reason).

identity_id.description: ID of the active email identity the campaign sends from.

failure_reason.description: Why the send ended in `failed`. Set by the send pipeline.

identity_id.description: ID of the active email identity the campaign sends from.

CampaignCreate.description: status and failure_reason are managed by the send pipeline and are rejected with 400. Set start_time to schedule a send; set it to null to cancel one.

identity_id.description: ID of the active email identity the campaign sends from.

CampaignUpdate.description: status and failure_reason are managed by the send pipeline and are rejected with 400. Set start_time to schedule a send; set it to null to cancel one.

Group.description: A recipient list within a campaign.

campaign_id.description: ID of the campaign the group belongs to.

Template.description: Reusable HTML content for a campaign email. Subject/name for the send itself live on Campaign - a template only carries the body markup.

html_body.description: HTML markup of the email body.

campaign_id.description: ID of the campaign the template belongs to.

Recipient.description: A person targeted by a campaign/group.

group_ids.description: Ids of the groups the recipient is in (many-to-many).
Groups the recipient joins. Each id must exist (400 otherwise). The retired single `group_id` is rejected with a 400.
When present, replaces the recipient's groups with exactly these. Omit to leave them unchanged.

campaign_id.description: Campaign the recipient is linked to directly.

Identity.description: A domain or email address an organization sends from.

type.description: Whether this identity is a domain or an email address.

identity.description: The domain name or email address being identified.

status.description: Set by SES verification: pending until AWS SES confirms ownership, then active. Only active identities can send.

verification_records.description: DNS records to add so SES can confirm a domain identity (1 TXT ownership record + 3 CNAME DKIM records). Null for email identities.

type.description: Whether this identity is a domain or an email address.

identity.description: The domain name or email address being identified.

IdentityCreate.description: status and verification_records are managed by SES verification and are rejected with 400.

IdentityUpdate.description: Only description is editable. type, identity, status and verification_records are rejected with 400: changing the address would keep an active status SES never verified, so create a new identity instead.

Claim.description: One CASL grant. Closed lists only: no `manage`/`all` wildcards, conditions, fields or inverted rules.

ApiKey.description: An API key - the only principal. The secret and its hash are never returned.

claims.description: Explicit claim list; duplicates are rejected.

preset.description: The preset the claims exactly match, or null for a custom list.

prefix.description: First characters of the secret, for recognition.

ApiKeySummary.description: What a caller without the `create Key` claim sees in GET /keys.

claims.description: Explicit claim list; duplicates are rejected.

preset.description: The preset the claims exactly match, or null for a custom list.

secret.description: The plaintext key (`mr_...`). Returned only here; store it now.

preset.description: viewer = read everything; editor = viewer + write Campaign/Template/Group/Recipient; admin = editor + update Organization and write Identity/Address/ContactDetails/Key.

claims.description: Explicit claim list; duplicates are rejected.

ApiKeyUpdate.description: Any subset of fields, but not both `preset` and `claims`. `expires_at: null` clears expiry.

preset.description: viewer = read everything; editor = viewer + write Campaign/Template/Group/Recipient; admin = editor + update Organization and write Identity/Address/ContactDetails/Key.

claims.description: Explicit claim list; duplicates are rejected.

Overview.description: Dashboard counts. A section is null when the calling key cannot `read` its subject.

recent.description: Latest campaigns whose send has started, newest first (max 5), each with its delivery counts.

bearerAuth.description: An API key (`mr_...`), minted at first boot, by `bun run key:create`, or by POST /keys.
